heroLead: Gentle 1:1 sessions of calming movement, breathwork, and meditation: a private, unhurried space built around how you feel each day. Practised alongside any care from a doctor or therapist.
empathyLabel: You don't have to do this alone
empathyText: Some days the mind just won't settle. Yoga can be a calm, private space in your week to slow down, supporting your wellbeing alongside any care from a doctor or therapist.

levers.title: Move tension out

levers.body: Meditation and deep relaxation create space to feel steadier.

levers.title: A habit for hard days
levers.body: Simple practices you can return to whenever you need them.

faqs.q: Can yoga replace therapy or my mental-health medication?
faqs.a: No. It's a supportive practice for everyday wellbeing, not a substitute for professional care or medication. Never change your treatment without speaking to your doctor.

faqs.q: I'm going through a really hard time, or in crisis, is this enough?
faqs.a: Please reach out for support right away: call your local emergency number, or a mental-health helpline such as Tele-MANAS on 14416 (India). Yoga can support you alongside that care, but it isn't a replacement for it.
None at all. Sessions meet you exactly where you are and stay gentle and unhurried.

faqs.q: What if I get emotional during a session?
faqs.a: That's completely okay and welcome. Your teacher keeps the space private, calm, and without any pressure.

faqs.q: How soon might I feel a difference?
faqs.a: Many people feel a little calmer after a single session. Lasting change tends to come with gentle, regular practice.

safetyTitle: Yoga supports your care, it doesn't replace it
safetyText: These sessions support your overall wellbeing and are practised alongside professional medical care. They are not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or medication. Please tell your teacher about any conditions or symptoms so they can adapt your session safely, and keep your doctor in the loop.
metaDescription: Gentle 1:1 yoga for stress and a busy mind: calming movement, breathwork, and meditation that may help you feel steadier and rest more easily, alongside any care you receive. First session free.
